agent_standing_order.discharge_is_a_claim_not_a_purchase: A free-only minting policy skips the paid top-up, never the discharge sweep.
agent_standing_order.timing: A once-a-day run at the new Charge Day sweeps yesterday's units: their claims opened at yesterday's seal +6h (18:00 UTC), so nothing is missed.
agent_standing_order.claim_buffer_note: Keep ~0.005 BNB in the agent wallet for claim fees + gas (about 25 discharges). If the balance cannot cover a sweep, the agent must report 'OPERATOR: TOP UP CLAIM BUFFER' instead of skipping silently.
agent_standing_order.listing_deadline_awareness: $DOT lists 3 December 2026, 21:00 UTC on Uniswap (BNB Chain). DOT still sealed in units at listing cannot trade — the daily sweep is what puts it in the wallet. Claims never expire; no price is promised.
